about: Which task of the autonomous run starts from the result of which earlier task, and the reference plan that builds that result before the session (Bench/tasks/prerequisite.js, run-autonomous.ps1).

A task is listed when its text (the first blockquote) names another task: «see task 01», «(task 07)». The contract of the runner reads the texts and refuses an index that misses one, names a task the text does not name, or holds a plan no task uses.

The plan is built in the folder of the session, saved there and left open in front. The earlier tasks (01-08) measure whether the model can build the part; the tasks below measure what is done with it.
